delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: This action is irreversible. Your personal data will be deleted and your forum contributions will be anonymized.

modal.title: Confirm account deletion
modal.lead: Before deleting your account, please read the following:

bullets.data: Your data (invoices, lists, comparisons, reports, etc.) will be deleted.
bullets.forum: Your forum posts will remain visible, but will be anonymized.
bullets.irreversible: This action is permanent and cannot be undone.

modal.confirmLabel: I understand and confirm the permanent deletion of my account.
modal.note: If you have an active subscription, you must cancel it (or wait until it ends) before deleting your account.

errors.requiresConfirm: You must check the confirmation box.
errors.subscriptionStillActive: Your subscription is still active. Please cancel it before deleting your account.
errors.lifetimeSubscription: A lifetime subscription was detected. Please contact an administrator to delete your account.
